trip.title: High desert, _long exposures_
trip.lede: Six days in the high basin with two working photographers: dawn on the mesas, midday in the slot washes, dark-sky nights at camp. We drive the long legs so you can spend the good light shooting.

days.text: Meet at the Corvo Junction depot at 13:00 for a kit check, then out to the flats for the first sunset and a first night of star trails.

sleep.name: Ash Flats camp
sleep.detail: bell tents with cots, shared washroom

note.label: Light
note.text: Sunset is near 17:50 on the autumn departures, with golden hour from about 17:10.

days.text: A start before dawn for low side light on the flats, then up the rim road. Midday is for editing and a rest; the evening is on the rim edge.

sleep.name: Tinaja Rim camp
sleep.detail: bell tents with cots, shared washroom

optional.label: Walk to the rim arch, 4 km there and back

days.text: Down onto the dry lake for the salt crust at blue hour. Wide lenses, and a tripod you trust in the wind.

optional.label: Drone session where the rules allow it

days.text: The slot washes: reflected light between narrow walls. Walks on sand, with some scrambling over dry falls up to 2 m high.

sleep.name: Sable Wash camp
sleep.detail: bell tents with cots, shared washroom

optional.label: A second slot, 6 km there and back, for the keen

note.label: Heat
note.text: We are in the washes before 11:00 and out of them by midday.

days.text: A short drive to the butte, a long-exposure workshop in the afternoon, and the last night under the darkest sky of the trip.

sleep.name: Kestrel Butte camp
sleep.detail: bell tents with cots, shared washroom

optional.label: Portraits at camp by lantern light

days.text: Sunrise on the butte, breakfast, then the long drive back with a portfolio review on the way. At the depot by 16:00.

sleep.detail: the depot motel can be booked for you

included: All driving in high-clearance vehicles, with fuel and permits
Tripods and filters to borrow, and a dark-sky field guide
notIncluded: Getting to Corvo Junction, and home from there
Drone permits, if you bring a drone

price.per: per person, sharing a tent or room with one other
covers: Every meal marked on the days above
Two photographers for the whole tour
All driving, fuel and park permits
Loan tripods, filters and a field guide
